tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Find crypto tokens by name, ticker symbol, or contract address. Returns summaries with price and market data. Use this first to resolve an identifier before calling get_token or get_risk_signals.

tools.name: get_token

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Current price, market cap, volume and 1h/24h/7d change for up to 50 tokens at once. Pass CoinGecko ids (preferred, e.g. 'bitcoin','ethereum') or symbols. Leave ids empty to get the top tokens by market cap.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Tokens with the most attention right now. source='coingecko' (default) returns the most-searched coins on CoinGecko; source='dex' returns the hottest on-chain DEX pools (optionally filtered by chain) — these are typically much newer and riskier.

tools.name: get_new_tokens
tools.description: Tokens whose first DEX liquidity pool was created in roughly the last hour, newest first. Extremely high risk by nature — always run get_risk_signals before acting. Filter by chain and minimum liquidity to cut noise.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_tokens" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find crypto tokens by name, ticker symbol, or contract address. Returns summaries with price and market data. Use this first to resolve an identifier before cal…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "build_token_launch_transaction" is 2244 chars, far longer than this server's median (321). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Launch a new token on Base through Flaunch. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction for the creator wallet to sign and send. The token gets a fixed 100bn supply that go…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "build_token_launch_transaction" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "post_token_comment" references sensitive artifacts (private key, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
